caption: the busiest week of december: a new moon and three planets changing direction. save it. dec 7 – 13, 2026.

slides.headline: the sky's busiest week of december starts *now*
new moon in *sagittarius*
slides.body: a fresh start for the honest version of you. set one intention, not ten.

slides.headline: *mercury* opposes uranus: the text you didn't see coming
slides.body: reads as surprise news and sudden opinions. reply after one breath.

slides.headline: *venus* squares pluto: jealousy, meet a mirror
slides.body: intense feelings, power games on offer. read it as a day to decline the game.

slides.headline: *saturn* turns direct in aries
slides.body: after months of apparent backing up, saturn holds still and moves forward again. stuck plans can start moving.

slides.headline: *venus* and mars get along for once
slides.body: the nicest aspect of the week. a good saturday to ask someone out properly.

slides.headline: *jupiter* turns retrograde in leo as neptune goes direct
slides.body: growth slows down to check its work. the fog lifts a little.

slides.headline: the one to watch: *saturday*
slides.body: venus sextile mars in the morning, jupiter stationing at night. a good day for a real date.
